title: A must in Barcelona
text:
If you’re visiting Barcelona, this Gothic Quarter tour is an absolute must! Our guide (Filipa) was welcoming, engaging, incredibly knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about bringing Barcelona’s rich history to life.

What made this experience so special was how personalized it felt. We ventured off the beaten path, discovering hidden gems, charming alleyways, and fascinating stories we never would have experienced on our own.

It felt less like a traditional tour and more like exploring the city with a wonderfully knowledgeable friend.

An authentic, memorable, and truly outstanding experi

title: Sophisticated and professional
text: Our guide Anna picked us up on time. She was very enthusiastic and immediately took us along a scale model to tell us as much as possible about Gaudi and the Sagrada Familia. She told really a lot and with a lot of enthusiasm. She knew how to answer all our questions. We really enjoyed it!

title: A great day and tour of Sagrada Família
text: Mel was our guide.  She was very knowledgeable and friendly.   Her enthusiasm about Sagrada Família showed throughout the tour.   Her English was very good.   We enjoyed it very much     We highly recommend Mel as a tour guide.   So lovely
